name: TutorRL-7B
summary: Open 7-billion-parameter math tutoring models, trained with reinforcement learning against a simulated student to guide students rather than give answers away.

license.note: The model cards say Apache-2.0, linking a LICENSE file the repository doesn't have; the repository's README and the paper say CC BY 4.0. Fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Apache-2.0).

cite: Dinucu-Jianu, D., Macina, J., Daheim, N., Hakimi, I., Gurevych, I., & Sachan, M. (2025). From Problem-Solving to Teaching Problem-Solving: Aligning LLMs with Pedagogy using Reinforcement Learning. EMNLP 2025. arXiv:2505.15607

fits.how: No slot: it is a model, which the harness can run as an agent's model through an OpenAI-compatible server.
